entries.title: 10-year luck cycles
entries.content: Daeun are 10-year periods that step forward or back from your month pillar. Each decade is read as a different 'climate' for your chart.
entries.source: Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia; Luck Pillars (dayun)
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Helpful and unhelpful elements
entries.content: Readers ask whether a decade brings the element your chart needs for balance or one it already has too much of. Hard decades are read as times to move carefully, not as fixed bad luck.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: The twelve-stage cycle
entries.content: Tradition describes a 12-stage life curve, from birth through peak to rest, that a stem moves through. It is used to talk about rising and falling energy over time.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
